title: Refactor cognitive complexity — ChatServices.cs (6 methods, range 16-34)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
6 methods in `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` exceed the cognitive complexity limit of 15:
- L516 (34), L1025 (34), L3074 (29), L3452 (20), L3359 (18), L2969 (16)

## Impact
These methods are difficult to understand, test, and maintain. ChatServices.cs is already the most problematic file in the codebase (62 issues total).

## Action Required
Decompose each method: extract nested conditionals into guard clauses, split by responsibility, extract inline switch/if chains into separate handler methods.

## Effort
~36min

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
